h1.cap: Who has more power... the boss everyone fears... or the one nobody wants to lose?

n2.cap: Two thinkers, centuries apart... two answers.

n3.cap: In essence, Machiavelli says... better feared than loved, if you must choose. But never... be hated.

q1.cap: He wrote... "the best possible fortress is... not to be hated by the people."

n4.cap: Walls, titles, money... none of it saves you if your people want you gone.

n5.cap: In essence... Rumi turns from the battle outside... to the battle within.

q2.cap: His words... "the (true) lion is he that breaks (conquers) himself."

n6.cap: A team captain. Best player on the pitch. One bad call... he shoves the referee. Red card. Final... without him.

n7.cap: Nobody beat him. His own temper did.

n8.cap: Machiavelli guards the walls. Rumi guards the gate inside. Real power needs both... and it starts inside.

n9.cap: Today, catch one urge... to snap, to quit, to scroll... and don't obey it.

n10.cap: Which battle is harder for you... outside or inside? Comment below.

n11.cap: Follow Awazzzz... and be the true lion.
